notes.title: Credits and Things
notes.content:
I hope everyone is having a great time playing block hopper. This update contains:

-Removing the Christmas hat from the character
-adding a credits list 

and you won't believe it that is all. I will continue working on this game and finding any left over bugs but my focus will be shifting slightly to a new video game I am working on.

notes.title: First Year Anniversary!
notes.content:
It has been a wonderful year full of lots of ups and downs. I am very happy with how far the game has come, Thank you to everyone who chose to support the game it is largely appreciated. 

I am happy to announce that I will be working on a new video game during a 24-hour Live stream on my Twitch next week on February 6th at 11:00 am EST on twitch.tv/cmdrshooter101. Depending on if we reach a certain goal that game will be uploaded for free here on Steam.

Also to celebrate the first year after launch Block Hopper is now 75% off until February 6th! 

I hope you all had a good New Year and Christmas and I can't wait to see what the future may hold.

notes.title: Minor Patch
notes.content:
Fixed Winter Level Music Slider 
and Fixed level 4 so it is now possible!

notes.title: Winter Update Now Live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, after lots of work I finally present Block Hoppers Winter Update to you!

This update includes new features I will let you discover in the levels and a few new achievements!

Added:
- Animations 
- Lots of new assets
- Some new graphic shading
- New obstacles 
and many more!


I want to thank everyone who has supported the game it has been an awesome year!

I wish you all a Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays, and a Happy New Year!

notes.title: Minor Bug Fix
notes.content: Made it so levels will no longer crash after being selected.

notes.title: Bug and Performance Fixes
notes.content:
I noticed a few major issues last time I tried playing so I have addressed these major concerns. 

-Fixed the pause menu breaking the game when you went into options by removing options from the pause menu
-Fixed the performance as the game was extraordinarily laggy, especially in the fall levels
- added level loading so that levels will load fully before you enter them.

notes.title: Fixed Textures
notes.content:
Fixed some missing textures in the new levels. 

Fixed launch directory.

notes.title: Fall Update
notes.content:
Hello, 
To start, thank you for supporting the game. This update not only adds some new content to the experience and adds some variety to some of the levels but also addresses several issues that have been brought forward to me by you. 

[u][b]Added:[/b][/u]
- New bonus levels with a fall theme 
- New obstacles to experience. 
- More variants to endless mode
- Changed the look of some of the levels
- Added controller support except for the pause menu 

[u][b]Fixed:[/b][/u]
- It is now harder to fall off the level in the Ultra Level
- Fixed the reset boxes to properly reset your position when you fall off 
- Fixed several lighting issues.

notes.title: Fall Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I want to start by saying thank you for getting the game and supporting it. 

That being said Block Hopper will be getting a new update that will include multiple bug fixes and visual treats. Coming September first, 2024 the fall update will come out. I hope you will all enjoy the small new things I have added to the game and I hope that you look forward to the new levels as well. 

Thanks once again for supporting the game and myself!

notes.title: Endless Mode Released!
notes.content:
After many hours of complicated bugs, weird crashes, issues with the scoring system, and a lack of resources to make a real leaderboard, there is now an endless mode that will get updates and expansions in the future.

I look forward to seeing the high score everyone sets. I also look forward to seeing the feedback on this new game mode. 

I am glad to have finally mostly realized the dream for this game and now have the ability to work on new and amazing projects.

notes.title: Endless Game Mode Update
notes.content: After multiple attempts and different approaches to the leaderboard situation, I have found currently with a lack of funds I can not connect the endless mode to a steam leaderboard. I have tried some alternative routes and none have been fruitful so for now endless mode will come out with a functional score system. you can even post your scores in the block hopper discord when the game mode is released.

notes.title: Big Level Fixed
notes.content: On recent play testings, I found out you couldn't beat the big level after the movement update well that is not a problem anymore the game is beatable. Also ignore that new button in the game modes tab for now ;)

notes.title: New Game Mode!
notes.content:
I have been spending the past little while testing and playing with the idea of a game mode that would add some replayability as well as some community challenge. 

I had first attempted to make this mode before release but it fell flat due to my inability to update the engine. Due to not thinking about it.

I am pleased to announce that I am working on an endless mode that will also work with Steam leaderboards where you will be able to compete with others that play the game and see who can make it the furthest. 

I am hoping to get this out soon just dealing with a few minor bugs, making some music, and getting the leaderboard set up.

notes.title: Movement, Sounds effects, and Menu Changes Oh My!
notes.content:
Movement Changes:
Added the ability to move in the air to control landings 

Ui Changes:
Made the menu text easier to read.
Made the pause menu text easier to read.

SFX Changes:
Added sound effects to moving spikes
Added sound effects to moving platforms
Added sound effects to Surprise entity 

Changes overall:
Added surprise entity

notes.title: Achievements!
notes.content:
I have finally added some starting achievements to the game and will be adding more.

There are five new achievements and one of them you must discover yourself. Experiment with the game have fun and enjoy the world. 

Along with this update, the game will be on sale with a 20% discount.

Also, check out the ultra level that has been in for a while, it is a casual game mode with no dying (unless you fall off... I mean what?) 

I hope you all continue to enjoy this game and I appreciate all the support very much!

If you have any recommendations please let me know!

Also if you want to challenge yourself check out the speed run page for Block Hopper: https://www.speedrun.com/Block_Hopper

notes.title: Quality of Life and Recommended Changes
notes.content:
In this update, I present to you some minor changes but changes that I think will change the way you play the game or enjoy the game by a significant amount. 

List of changes:
- There no longer is eye adaptation/light adaptation. 
- There is a level selector for the casual game mode so you don't need to start again when you leave the game
- The camera has been zoomed out to give the ability to see more things and hopefully get a better understanding of the levels. 
- some of the levels have had minor adjustments in obstacles 
- Brightness has been increased slightly to make the darker levels easier but not increased so much that it will affect the lighter levels by much

I hope you all had a good easter weekend and I hope you enjoy this update in this fun but annoying game!

notes.title: Menu and Performance Patch
notes.content:
Some reflections have been reduced drastically to improve performance. 

As well as the options menu has had a color pallet update in hopes of making it easier to read and interact with.

notes.title: New Game Mode!
notes.content:
I am excited to bring to you a nice new game mode that is a longer level that has its puzzles and challenges. I hope you enjoy playing this game mode and I always appreciate getting feedback. 

Fixed:
Volume sliders keep their value 
Fixed some potential performance issues. 

Added:
New music was added for levels 5 and 6
New assets made for new game mode 
A new game mode was implemented 
A new save function was added for the new game mode


I am very much looking forward to seeing where this game goes and seeing where the community goes. 
Also for any potential speedrunners who may be lurking in the shadows the game can be found on speedrun.com.

notes.title: DEV NOTE!
notes.content:
I am currently working on a new game mode which will contain an "Ultra-Level" if you will. The game mode will be full of surprises and things that are not included in the game as it is right now. It should be a  fun time and it has its hidden puzzles. 

Also due to some feedback about the volume and menus I have been working on making the volume sliders easier to use and putting them back into the options in the game instead of only in the main menu. 

Also I have plans to make the game a little more fun as a community thing and will be adding stuff for community made levels I currently do not have a timeline for this as I want to avoid making promises I can't keep while focusing on making a good game.

notes.title: Minor Patch
notes.content: The menu has been reformatted and also the launch directory slightly changed and fixed.

notes.title: Launch Day
notes.content: Launch day! I am very excited to bring you Block Hopper. Please give me feedback and things I can work on. Block Hopper will be receiving two new game modes sometime shortly as well as some minor patches and updates as things get found. I hope you enjoy this somewhat goofy and rage-inducing game!
